description: This Java interface defines a service for reading and retrieving account transfer data within the Fineract core project. It declares methods for retrieving transfer templates, individual transfers, collections of transfers based on search parameters, and specific related data such as transaction IDs and total transaction amounts.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Fetches a transfer template based on origin and destination account and client details.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all account transfer data matching specific search parameters.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific account transfer by its transfer ID.

methods.name: isAccountTransfer
methods.description: Checks if a given transaction ID corresponds to an account transfer of a specific account type.

methods.name: retrieveByStandingInstruction
methods.description: Retrieves account transfer data associated with a standing instruction identified by given ID.

methods.name: fetchPostInterestTransactionIds
methods.description: Fetches transaction IDs related to post-interest activities for a specific account.

methods.name: fetchPostInterestTransactionIdsWithPivotDate
methods.description: Fetches transaction IDs related to post-interest activities for a specific account, filtered by a pivot date.

methods.name: retrieveRefundByTransferTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves refund transfer data based on transfer template details.

methods.name: getTotalTransactionAmount
methods.description: Calculates the total transaction amount for an account on a specific date.
